{{Top|leg}}
'''Oxygen tanks''' were a vital [[Life support/Legends|life support]] mechanism used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. With [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] an important commodity, the [[Tasari]] manufactured a number of oxygen tanks for use with their technology. The construction of the tanks was a project undertaken by the community, and Tasari convicted for minor crimes were sentenced to work building oxygen tanks.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>

Oxygen tanks were installed on [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], [[pressure tent]]s, and ground vehicles. The units were manufactured in two different sizes, one for individual use, and one for larger applications such as vehicles and shelters. The oxygen tanks were intended to be reused although due to their low cost were considered to be replaceable by off-worlders. The Tasari used [[Filling Station]]s within their settlements to recharge the oxygen tanks.<ref name="J15" />
